sloka: ततस्तमसि सञ्जाते सर्वे ते देवराक्षसाः ।अयुद्ध्यन्त बलोन्मत्ताः सूदयन्तः परस्परम् ।। ७.२९.१ ॥
transliteration: tatastamasi sañjāte sarve te devarākṣasāḥ ।ayuddhyanta balonmattāḥ sūdayantaḥ parasparam ।। 7.29.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, with the darkness having arisen, all those gods and demons, intoxicated with their strength, fought, slaying each other.
